mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened corporate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive during sustained GDPC1 growth, or when other macro variables (e.g., GDP growth) contradict the demand narrative.

mechanism_narrative: A one-month rise in FEDFUNDS above 2% triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates reducing equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 2% in the trigger period, or when other indicators (e.g., yield curve steepening) contradict the rate hike expectation.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of FEDFUNDS below 1% and UNRATE declining predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as dual accommodative policies boost market confidence.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both FEDFUNDS <1% and UNRATE decline, or when other variables (e.g., GDP growth) contradict the policy synergy.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as markets anticipate prolonged accommodative policy.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive during FEDFUNDS declines in late-cycle periods, or when other late-cycle indicators (e.g., corporate earnings growth) contradict the policy expectation.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in UNRATE below 4.5% predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as lower unemployment signals labor market strength and consumer spending.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when UNRATE falls below 4.5%, or when other labor metrics (e.g., PAYEMS growth) do not align with the unemployment decline.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in INDPRO above 105.0 predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as stronger supply growth supports corporate earnings and productivity.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive during INDPRO increases above 105.0, or when other supply indicators (e.g., production data) contradict the growth narrative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and decline in UNRATE (labor) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as dual indicators of economic expansion boost market confidence.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both GDPC1 rises and UNRATE falls, or when other growth indicators (e.g., corporate profits) contradict the dual signal.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS above 150,000 predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as strong employment growth signals robust labor market and consumer spending.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000, or when other labor metrics (e.g., UNRATE) do not align with the employment surge.
